signals.evidence: Popular YouTube channel Gyan Therapy discussed issues with astrology services, highlighting scams and trust issues.
Users on r/astrology express dissatisfaction with lack of detailed reports from services like AstroTalk.
Users are complaining about unexpected high bills from per-minute astrology services.

ideas.name: AstroTalk Credibility Crisis
ideas.why_it_converts: Users paying for astrology are mid-funnel buyers, burned and actively seeking alternatives. Addressing trust issues and offering transparent pricing can attract these users.

ideas.name: Comprehensive Astrology Reports
ideas.why_it_converts: By providing detailed written reports, we can fill the feature gap and attract users dissatisfied with competitors.

ideas.name: Transparent Flat-Rate Pricing
ideas.why_it_converts: Offering a simple flat-rate pricing model can alleviate price complaints and attract users wary of per-minute billing scams.
